top_signals.title: SpaceX Launches Crew for NASA on Retiring Dragon Capsule
top_signals.summary:
SpaceX launched a new crew of four astronauts to the International Space Station, as questions swirl over the company’s plans for the future of its human spaceflight program.
Once at the ISS, the crew will live and work there for the next six months.
The mission is the latest in a series of flights that SpaceX performs for NASA to ensure the ISS is staffed at all times. (Source: Bloomberg)
